name: Asa
overview: Asa, king of Judah and son of Abijam, reigned for forty-one years in Jerusalem and is commended for doing what was right in the eyes of the LORD, following the example of King David. His reign was marked by a decisive removal of idolatry and immoral practices, including the removal of sodomites and idols established by his ancestors. Notably, Asa took a firm stand against idolatry even within his own family by deposing his mother Maachah from her position as queen because of her idolatrous worship, which he then destroyed. These actions reflect Asa's commitment to covenant faithfulness and spiritual reform in Judah.
